nodes.title: SG-8.3 Submit button disabled and loading states with inline success feedback
nodes.body:
Context: ContributionSheet (game/frontend/src/components/ContributionSheet.tsx) currently disables Send only when remaining <= 0 (L129). Blank and over-limit text leave it enabled, there is no in-flight guard, and the button label never changes. Success is shown only as a per-entry 'Sent' label in the list; errors show in a role=alert paragraph. Desired behavior: Send is disabled for blank, over-limit, zero quota and in-flight submissions, shows a loading label while in flight, and an inline success message appears after a successful send alongside the existing error message. Why: players get immediate, unambiguous feedback and cannot double-submit.

## Acceptance criteria
- Given blank or whitespace-only text, over-limit text, zero remaining quota, or a submission in flight, when the sheet renders, then the Send button is disabled.
- Given a submission in flight, when the sheet renders, then the button label reads 'Sending…' and returns to 'Send' when the request settles.
- Given a successful submission, when it resolves, then an inline role=status message 'Suggestion sent' is shown and a failed submission still shows the existing role=alert error.


## Scope
- In scope: ContributionSheet Send button disabled and loading states
- In scope: Inline success message
- Out of scope: Backend API changes
- Out of scope: Contribution history list changes
- Out of scope: Quota or max length constants
- Preserve: Existing handleSubmit guards and validation messages
- Preserve: errorMessage mapping
- Preserve: Radix Dialog focus behavior
- Preserve: API contract of submitContribution and listMine


## Technical constraints
- Frontend only: React + TypeScript in game/frontend
- No new dependencies


## Definition of done
- All three requirements are implemented and their unit tests pass


## Non-functional requirements
- Disabled and status states are announced accessibly (disabled attribute, role=status)


## Clarifying questions
- None

nodes.title: REQ · Send is disabled when text is blank, over limit, quota is exhausted or a send is in flight
nodes.body:
Context: ContributionSheet Send is disabled only at zero quota. Desired behavior: disabled whenever trimmed text is empty, length exceeds MAX_PROMPT_LENGTH, remaining <= 0, or a submission is pending. Expected result: no click can start an invalid or duplicate submission. Why: prevents invalid and double submits.

## Acceptance criteria
- Given empty or whitespace-only text, when the sheet renders, then Send is disabled.
- Given text longer than MAX_PROMPT_LENGTH, when the sheet renders, then Send is disabled.
- Given remaining quota is 0, when the sheet renders, then Send is disabled.
- Given a submission whose promise has not settled, when the sheet renders, then Send is disabled.


## Scope
- In scope: disabled attribute computation on Send
- Out of scope: Label change
- Out of scope: Success message
- Preserve: handleSubmit guards for blank, over limit and quota
- Preserve: Inline validation messages


## Technical constraints
- handleSubmit keeps its own guards because the form can be submitted with Enter or programmatically


## Definition of done
- Send disabled in all four conditions and enabled for valid text with quota


## Clarifying questions
- None

nodes.title: REQ · Send shows a loading label while the submission is in flight
nodes.body:
Context: the button always reads 'Send'. Desired behavior: while submitContribution is pending, the label is 'Sending…'; it reverts to 'Send' on success or failure. Why: visible progress feedback.

## Acceptance criteria
- Given a pending submitContribution, when the sheet renders, then the button name is 'Sending…'.
- Given the request resolved or rejected, when the sheet re-renders, then the button name is 'Send' again.


## Scope
- In scope: Send button label
- Out of scope: Spinner icons
- Out of scope: Entry list state labels
- Preserve: Per-entry 'Sending…' label in the list


## Technical constraints
- Reuse the in-flight state introduced for REQ-1 (a single 'submitting' boolean)


## Definition of done
- Label toggles with in-flight state


## Clarifying questions
- None

nodes.title: REQ · Inline success feedback is shown after a successful send alongside the existing error feedback
nodes.body:
Context: success is only implied by the entry's 'Sent' label. Desired behavior: after submitContribution resolves, show 'Suggestion sent' in a role=status paragraph; clear it when the user types or starts another send; a failure clears it and shows the existing error. Why: explicit confirmation to the player.

## Acceptance criteria
- Given submitContribution resolves, when the request settles, then a role=status element with 'Suggestion sent' is visible and no error alert is shown.
- Given submitContribution rejects with 429, when the request settles, then the 'Slow down, try again shortly' alert is shown and the success message is absent.
- Given a visible success message, when the user types in the textarea, then the success message is removed.


## Scope
- In scope: success message state and rendering
- Out of scope: Toast or animation
- Out of scope: Changing error wording
- Preserve: errorMessage function and the role=alert error paragraph


## Technical constraints
- Success message is inside the sheet, not a global toast


## Definition of done
- Success and error messages are mutually exclusive and clear correctly


## Non-functional requirements
- Success message uses role=status so it is announced politely


## Clarifying questions
- None

- handleSubmit returns early when submitting is true.

- Out of scope: Label and success message

## Technical constraints

- Code path: `game/frontend/src/components/ContributionSheet.tsx`

steps.action: Add a boolean state 'submitting' initialised to false next to the existing validation state.
steps.expected: Component compiles with a new submitting state.

steps.action: Return early when submitting is true (first guard after preventDefault), call setSubmitting(true) right after the entries are queued (after L85), and call setSubmitting(false) in a finally block added to the existing try/catch.
steps.code: if (submitting || remaining <= 0) return; ... setSubmitting(true); try { await submitContribution(prompt); ... } catch (err) { ... } finally { setSubmitting(false); }
steps.expected: A second submit while the first promise is pending is ignored; submitting returns to false after resolve or reject.

steps.action: Replace the disabled prop with a computed value covering quota, blank text, over limit and in-flight.
steps.expected: Send is disabled for blank, whitespace-only, over-limit, zero-quota and in-flight states and enabled otherwise.
